text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, as the Halloween event at Tracen Academy drew near.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Ehh~~, I'm the one *getting* it?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
You were on 'giving duty' last year, weren't you?
Then this year, it's your turn to receive!
No need to be shy!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, thanks Biko-chan!
Well then, maybe I'll take you up on that offer~♪

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
All right, Trainer,
keep up with me, okay?
Let's get delicious sweets from everyone~♪

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Here I come~, trick or treat~~♪

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Rawr, rawrr!
Trick or treat, or you're going in the stew pot~!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Aha, Akebono-chan's hyped up!
Hot pot ingredients, seriously? That's hilarious!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, being eaten would be quite a problem.
Here, have some of these sweets instead.
They're horseshoe-shaped cookies.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Yaaay!
Thank you both~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I'm a circus ghost~~!
If you don't give me treats,
I'll trap you inside my magic tent~!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Oh my, what a cute little ghost♪
Getting caught and spending time together sounds fun too, though."

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Happy Marvelous☆
I've got just the thing for you, Akebono! Prepared special!
Marvelous-packed Horseshoe Cookies★☆
choice_data_list: (Huh? Is that the same shaped cookie as before?)

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"There you are, Phantom Halloween Bono!
Take this, my special move: Horseshoe Cookie Attaaack!!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaa, you got meee!
...Ehehe, Biko-chan, your cookies are just too lethal~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I got sooooooo much!
Hehehe, so happy~♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Today, Hishi Akebono received lots of sweets.
What caught her eye, however, was that all of them
were thick, horseshoe-shaped cookies."
choice_data_list: (Was there always a rule like that for Halloween?)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Well then, down the hatch right away~♪

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
...Huh?
There's something inside the cookie...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Paper...?
What's this, what's this... What could it be?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When Hishi Akebono cracked open the cookies, they were
hollow inside... and from every single cookie came
a long, narrow strip of paper with writing on it.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"Ehh~~!?
Could this, could this be...?!?!"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"Happy Halloween!
Here's a payback for your legit-touching story!"

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"Hex, hex!
Here's a little spell to make Halloween extra fun for you, Akebono!"

text_block_list.name: Everyone's Messages
text_block_list.text:
"Surprised? This is a thank-you for last year♪"
"Making things is so fun, let's do it together next time!"
"We love you, Bono-chan♡"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ngggh!
Amazing, amazing! There's so much!
I wonder how long everyone spent preparing all this~?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! My heart is just so, so warm!
I can't keep all this happiness
to myself~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
There's no way I'm not sharing
something like this with everyone!
...Alriii~~ght!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Sparkly summon~☆ Akebono, what is it, what is it?
I've got a feeling it's full of marvelous~★☆

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe! I wanted to make the happiness
you gave me yesterday waaaay bigger!
So, you see—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Ta-daaaa~n!!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Huuu...uuuge!!
What is this, a mountain of ice cream!?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Mar~ve~lous☆★☆
It looks big enough to feed everyone at the academy★

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Heh-heh-heh~♪ Made with the cookies I got, it's chunky cookie ice cream! Here's everyone's share!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Amazing, so many of them...!
Considering it just happened yesterday, it feels like magic.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: However, isn't this a bit too much? This was supposed to be a return gift for last year, so getting another this year makes me feel terribly guilty.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, not at all!
You really don't need to think that way!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I mean, Halloween is a wonderful event
where everyone can have fun and smile, right?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
The people getting sweets, and the people giving them—
everyone, every single one of them gets to be happy!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
You know, everyone's surprise
made me so thrilled!
It was so much fun, it warmed my heart right up!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"So if I take the 'fun' I was given
and return it as an e~ven bigger 'fun'—"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: I thought we could all become one big, warm chanko nabe together~âª

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
That means you can make everyone smile!
You're amazing, Bono!
Just like a real hero!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, thanks!
Alright everyone, how about we get our buono Halloween ice cream party started?!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Here you go, Trainer-san♪
Some party leftovers to share~☆
choice_data_list: That is a huge ice cream!?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I just wanted to share
plenty of "buono" with you too, Trainer-san♪

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Would you like tea? Or coffee?
I'll get it ready right away,
so just give me a moment~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
And then, and then!
We all ate ice cream while watching a movie~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: It was a horror comedy, but Biko had her eyes squeezed shut the whole time. Between the screaming and all the excitement, it was super fun~!
choice_data_list: Looks like you had a wonderful time.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Everyone's smiling and having fun...
I hope we can all enjoy Halloween together
again next year~♪
